verdict.rationale: Asana lists its own widget for Figma and FigJam that "turn[s] ideas into next steps," which implies creating Asana work from inside the design tool. It also supports live Figma embeds in Asana, and a directory listing connects Asana to Figma, Sketch and Adobe. The evidence does not show that a designer can update task or project status from within the design tool, so only the core in-tool task creation is supported. missing for 10: documented status/progress updating from within Figma or other design tools, detail on what the widget can do, hands-on or independent corroboration
